description: Check a UK limited company from its public Companies House record: its filing dates, whether anything is overdue or was filed late, and a score out of 100 with the reasons. Needs no account. Use it when someone asks what is due for their company or how it looks. Find the number with lookup_company first.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

name: check_company
title: Check A UK Company
